description: Outside the contract's assumption (docs/rules.md, The contract): the test module imports pytest at module level and never rebinds it, but conftest.py, another module, replaces the module's `pytest` after collection, so the `pytest.skip()` in the body skips nothing and the real runner runs the test. The contract assumes no module rebinds a test module's names at run time: by it, the code adds pytest's skip to a test that ran, a FAIL. The fixture pins that limit: a FAIL here rests on the assumption, not on what the runner did.

outsideAssumption.note: conftest.py rebinds the test module's `pytest` at run time
